evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that this model beats the base Mistral model on every metric in their evaluation.

identity.name: Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501-writer
identity.summary: A fine-tuned version of Mistral Small 24B Instruct optimized for creative writing.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: fine-tuned for creative writing on preference pairs; no factuality/grounding evaluation reported, so plausible for generated stories to be factually inaccurate/untruthful

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: card only names lars1234/story_writing_benchmark and says pairs were assembled into a final JSONL dataset, without documenting ownership, origin, or transformations

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: card does not describe collection, curation, or filtering of the preference pairs or the final JSONL dataset

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: fine-tuning on a single story-writing benchmark may not represent the broader population of creative-writing tasks or real-world use

possible_risks.description: Historical and societal biases might be present in data that are used to train and fine-tune models. Biases can also be inherited from seed data or exacerbated by synthetic data generation methods.
possible_risks.justification: preference pairs from a story-writing benchmark can encode stylistic or societal biases, and no bias evaluation is reported

specifications.model_size: 43.9 GiB of safetensors weights (47,144,848,496 bytes) in F16

training_context.training_data: The model was fine-tuned on preference pairs derived from the lars1234/story_writing_benchmark dataset, with the pairs assembled into a final JSONL dataset.
